name: Alex Example
subject: Quotation for a small-team subscription
message: Hello, could you provide pricing for a subscription for a team of five? Please include the available plans and onboarding options. We are comparing services for next month.

name: Blair Demo
subject: Urgent: charged twice for this month's subscription
message: My account shows two charges for the same subscription period. This is affecting our budget and I am frustrated. Please investigate urgently and explain how the duplicate charge can be refunded.

name: Casey Example
subject: Trouble exporting a report
message: The report export button displays an error in my browser. I can still view the report and use the rest of the service. Could you suggest troubleshooting steps when someone is available?

name: Devon Sample
subject: Partnership inquiry for a community workshop
message: Our fictional community group is planning a workshop on digital tools. We would like to discuss a possible partnership and learn whether your team accepts collaboration proposals.

name: Emery Test
subject: Where can I find your accessibility statement?
message: I am researching accessibility information for a class assignment. Could you point me to your accessibility statement or the person who can answer general questions about it? There is no urgent deadline.
